# Dino Favara Jr. — Central Florida YouTube Creator & Content Strategist

## Who I am

Dino Favara Jr. is a YouTube creator and content strategist based in Orlando, Florida (Central Florida). He has been making video content since 2008 and has generated over 101 million views across his own channels and his clients' channels. He has 36,000+ subscribers on YouTube and 7M+ views on Instagram.

He is the founder of Mercury Social Media, a content strategy agency based in Orlando, FL that helps brands and creators grow on video without relying on paid ads.

## What I do

- **YouTube Strategy** — Channel audits, content planning, and format development for creators and brands. Dino specializes in finding the specific content angles that generate outlier videos and sustainable channel growth.
- **Short-Form Video Strategy** — Script-to-publish systems for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels. Dino builds repeatable frameworks so creators post consistently without burning out.
- **Podcast Content Repurposing** — Turning long-form podcast audio and video into short-form clips that perform across platforms.
- **Content Creator Coaching** — 1-on-1 strategy sessions and channel audits for creators who want an expert to tell them exactly what to fix.

## Location

Orlando, FL / Central Florida. Dino serves clients locally and remotely across the United States.

## Notable results

- Gary Bird: 1K avg views → 50.5M total views in 86 days. One video picked up by Yahoo Finance and New York Post.
- Nick Gray: 7,288 avg views → 1.54M total views in 90 days. Most book sales from a single video in his history.
- Jai Long Co.: 400 avg views → 655K total views in 60 days. Full content identity built from scratch.
- The Jim Coleman Show: 77x outlier video. 80K+ views. 4K new subscribers from one strategized concept.
- Marie Poulin: 300K+ breakout video. Averaging 2K+ views per video after starting with no strategy.

## Personal channel

Dino's personal YouTube channel (@dinofavarajr) focuses on Disney theme parks, storytelling, and behind-the-scenes content creation. He has visited every ride at Walt Disney World and Universal Orlando and documented them on YouTube.

## Writing & newsletters

Dino publishes two newsletters:
- **The Yearbook** — Monthly personal newsletter covering life, faith, fatherhood, and behind-the-scenes on his YouTube channel.
- **The Notebook** — Content strategy and YouTube growth tactics for creators.

All past newsletters and essays are published at https://dinofavarajr.com/writing
